tableInfo.name: 装置ログデータ
tableInfo.sqlForTool: WITH PAT_FLG_LIST AS ( SELECT a.OPE_CD , CASE WHEN n.PAT_FLG= '1' THEN CASE WHEN n.ALARM_FLG='2' THEN CASE WHEN VALUE in('0','1','4','5') THEN '1' ELSE '2' END WHEN n.ALARM_FLG='1' THEN CASE WHEN VALUE in('0','1','2','3') THEN '1' ELSE '2' END ELSE CASE WHEN VALUE in('0','2','4','6') THEN '1' ELSE '2' END END ELSE '0' END AS PAT_FLG FROM MST_LOG_MESSAGE a INNER JOIN MST_LOG_MESSAGE_SUB_NEW n ON a.OPE_CD = n.OPE_CD AND a.UP_DATE = n.UP_DATE and n.SERIES_CD='{4}' CROSS JOIN (SELECT VALUE FROM SYS_SYSTEM_DEFINE WHERE ID='511' and SERIES_CD='{4}' ) ) SELECT ldl.OCCUR_DATE as event_reg_date, null as m_notice_status, ldl.LOG_SEQ_NO as log_seq_no, null as device_edge_no, ldl.DEVICE_NO as machine_type_cd, ldl.DEVICE_NO as machine_serial, ldl.DEVICE_NO as com_format_cd, 1 as data_type, null as test_type, null as gathering_manage_no, null as email_send_date, null as email_text, trim(ldl.LOG_CD) as machine_record_cd, ldl.LOG_MESSAGE as machine_record_message, null as contents, ldl.LOG_NUMBER1 || ',' || ldl.LOG_NUMBER2 || ',' || ldl.LOG_NUMBER3 || ',' || ldl.LOG_NUMBER4 as machine_record_aux_data, null as email_address, '0' as email_name, null as remarks, 0 as is_correction, null as user_id, case when rd.DEVICE_NO is not null then rd.DIALYSIS_NO || ',' || TO_CHAR(ldl.occur_date,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') else null end as ord_no, 0 as log_type, ldl.OCCUR_DATE as reg_date, ldl.OCCUR_DATE as up_date, null as is_correction_up_date, 0 as service_support_type, null as service_support_user_id, null as service_support_up_date, CASE WHEN P.PAT_FLG IN('1','0') THEN '0' ELSE '1' END as REPORT_DISP_FLG, ldl.OCCUR_DATE as occur_date, null as m_notice_status, ldl.DEVICE_NO as device_no, ldl.LOG_CD as log_cd, ldl.LOG_MESSAGE as log_message, ldl.LOG_NUMBER1 || ',' || ldl.LOG_NUMBER2 || ',' || ldl.LOG_NUMBER3 || ',' || ldl.LOG_NUMBER4 as log_number, '1' as device_type FROM ({0}) ldl INNER JOIN MST_DEVICE m on m.DEVICE_NO=ldl.DEVICE_NO and m.SERIES_CD='{4}' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM MST_DEVICE b WHERE m.DEVICE_NO = b.DEVICE_NO AND m.UP_DATE < b.UP_DATE ) LEFT JOIN RST_DIALYSIS rd on ldl.DEVICE_NO =rd.DEVICE_NO and ldl.occur_date >= rd.ENTER_DATE AND ldl.occur_date <= rd.LEAVE_DATE and rd.REC_CLASS = '0' LEFT JOIN PAT_FLG_LIST P ON TRIM(P.OPE_CD) = TRIM(ldl.LOG_CD) WHERE ldl.OCCUR_DATE >=:START_DATE AND ldl.OCCUR_DATE < :END_DATE {1} order by ldl.OCCUR_DATE desc,ldl.LOG_MESSAGE

m.DEVICE_NO,m.UP_DATE ASC), SYSDATE) AS enddate FROM MST_DEVICE m where m.SERIES_CD='{4}' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM MST_DEVICE b WHERE m.DEVICE_NO = b.DEVICE_NO AND m.UP_DATE < b.UP_DATE ) ) a.DEVICE_NO=b.DEVICE_NO and event_reg_date>b.UP_DATE and event_reg_date<b.enddate) WHERE up_date >= :START_DATE AND up_date <:END_DATE {1}
